description: This file contains functions and interfaces related to analyzing chess positions, including determining attackers, defenders, and whether a piece is hanging, using the 'chess.js' library.

classes.name: InfluencingPiece
classes.description: Interface representing a chess piece that influences a specific square, including its position, color, and type.

methods.name: getBoardCoordinates
methods.description: Converts a square notation to x, y coordinates on the board.

methods.name: getSquare
methods.description: Converts x, y coordinates back to square notation.

methods.name: getAttackers
methods.description: Returns a list of pieces attacking a given square in a specific position.

methods.name: getDefenders
methods.description: Returns a list of pieces defending a given square in a specific position.

methods.name: isPieceHanging
methods.description: Determines if a piece on a given square is hanging (undefended or capturable).
